Ok, so there are quite a few image hosts now and all of you are struggling with finances/traffic/upkeep.

Postox is running Chevereto so the labour is minimal.

Someone going in with this approach is unlikely to want the labour-intensiveness of building a site from scratch, or they lack the expertise, which is why they licensed an all-in-one software solution in the first place. If they have money to throw at hosting they can keep it going indefinitely as a small player, but there is no room to grow. They offer nothing over another site running the same hosted software (there are 100's, if not 1,000's, of public free Chevereto-based sites).

The guys who write from scratch on the other hand have big dreams but no money. They'll keep coding even though they have no money and the site grows beyond their resources. But once in a while they break out and achieve "web scale".

Unfortunately the two types tend to disagree on how to run things, so we'll never see that perfect collaboration of talent and money.
